title: doronicum plantagineum subsp. emarginatum
intro: Doronicum plantagineum subsp. emarginatum, commonly known as Leopard's Bane, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Leopard's Bane include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
